mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS expense_record ( record_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, record_date DATE, expense_id INTEGER, memo VARCHAR(80), deposit INTEGER, withdraw INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY (expense_id) REFERENCES expense_category(expense_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS expense_category ( expense_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, expense_name VARCHAR(20)
)
mapper.select: SELECT r.record_date, c.expense_name, r.memo, r.deposit, r.withdraw FROM expense_record AS r LEFT JOIN expense_category AS c ON r.expense_id = c.expense_id ORDER BY r.record_date;
